answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 146414 Country: pakistan Title: Is it okay for a pet cat to sit on the bed and sofa and on our lap? Can we pick up a pet cat? Will there be an issue of impurity (napaaki)? Question: Is it okay for a pet cat to sit on the bed and sofa and on our lap? Can we pick up a pet cat? Will there be an issue of impurity (napaaki)? Answer ID: 146414 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 170/155/SD=3/1438) Yes, there is no harm if a pet sits on bed, sofa or lap. Cat is not najis al-ain (inherently impure). Yes, its urine etc are impure which one should avoid. قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : إنها ليست بنجس، إنها من الطوافين عليكم والطوافات ... (أبوداؤد) (الفتاوى الهندية: 1/46) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
